paras.t: If you kept a record of our sins,
who could escape being condemned?
But you forgive us,
so that we should fear you.
I wait eagerly for the Lord's help,
and in his word I trust.
I wait for the Lord,
more eagerly than watchmen wait for the dawn.
Israel, trust in the Lord,*
because his love is constant,
and he is always willing to save.
He will save his people Israel
from all their sins.
Eternal rest grant unto them, Lord,
and let perpetual light shine upon them.
O God, Creator and Redeemer of all the faithful, grant to the
souls of your servants remission of all their sins that through
our loving supplications, they may attain the favours they have
always desired, for you live and reign forever and ever, Amen.
Zion sing, break into song!
For within you is the Lord, with his saving pow'r.
1. Rise and shine forth, for your /light has come,
and upon you breaks the glory /of the Lord;
for the /darkness /covers the /earth,
and the thick /clouds, the /people.
2. But upon you the /Lord shall dawn,
and in you his splendour shall /be revealed;
your light shall /guide the /Gentiles on their /path,
and kings shall /walk in your /brightness.
1. Immaculate Mary, your praises we sing.
You reign now in splendour with Jesus our King.
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria! (2x)
2. In heaven the blessed your glory proclaim.
On earth we your children invoke your sweet name.
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria! (2x)
3. We pray for the Church, our true Mother on earth,
and beg you to watch o'er the land of our birth.
Ave, Ave, Ave, Maria! (2x)
1. Hail Virgin most holy, in mercy descending
to save us poor sinners from sorrows unending.
Ave, ave, ave Maria. (2x)
2. How calm is your shining above earth's commotion!
Give peace to the nations, you Star of the Ocean.
Ave, ave, ave Maria. (2x)
3. Our homes and our country we place in your keeping
to love you and serve you in gladness and weeping.
Ave, ave, ave Maria. (2x)

Hail Mary, full of grace,
hail to you.
Our sweetness, our mother,
hail to you.(2x)
Blessed Father Dominic,
holy Priest of God,
beloved Confessor,
renowned Preacher.
1. Man of the Lord's own choice,
we rejoice to have you
as our gracious advocate
before the Lord.
2. Light of the Church of Christ,
you preached God's truth to all.
You learnt this truth in prayer,
helped by the Virgin Queen.
3. Embrace true charity;
preserve humility;
treasure your poverty.
This is my will to you.

tie yen sufre.

1. Hail Saint Dominic our Father
Hail Oh friend of God to thee
Chosen knight of Christ and Mary
Guardian of the rosary
In the Sacred cause of Jesus
Bravely father you did fight
Drawing souls from paths of darkness
Spreading forth the gospel light.
2. Guard us ever sainted father
In your glorious family
Flying your unsullied banner
Love and Prayer and Purity
Stay oh stay with us kind father
As through life’s dark night we pass
Keep your children ever faithful
To your motto VERITAS.
You, you are the light of the Church
You, you are the doctor of truth
You, you are the rose of patience
You, you are the ivory of chastity
freely have you dispensed the waters of wisdom.
You, you are the preacher of grace.
Unite us with the blessed.
Dominic (3x) you are our father

blocks.text: To the tune of `All Creatures of our God and King'

paras.t: In Dominic we claim to be,
through all the world one family,
O praise God, laudare!
A living heritage we share,
of study common life and prayer.
Refrain: Laudare, Alleluia, Benedicere, Alleluia! Praedicare!
To east and west to south and north;
O sisters, brothers now go forth
Be a blessing, benedicere!
Throughout the universe release,
God's reign of justice, love and peace! R.
How beautiful upon the earth
the feet of those who bring God's word
Preach the Gospel, praedicare!
The path we walk is holy ground,
the word we speak a holy sound. R.
Out of the depths I cry to you, O Lord, * Lord, hear my voice!
O let your ears be attentive * to the voice of my pleading.
If you, O Lord, should mark our guilt, * Lord, who would survive?
But with you is found forgiveness: * for this we revere you.
My soul is waiting for the Lord, * I count on his word.
My soul is longing for the Lord * more than watchman for daybreak.
Let the watchman count on daybreak * and Israel on the Lord.
Because with the Lord there is mercy * and fullness or redemption,
Israel indeed he will redeem * From all its iniquity.
Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord
And let perpetual light shine upon them.

litany.text: God, the Son, Redeemer of the world,
Queen of the most holy Rosary,
Lamb of God, who take away the sins of the world,
Lamb of God, who take away the sins of the world,
Lamb of God, who take away the sins of the world.
Permit me to sing your praises holy Virgin !
Let us pray: Grant us, Lord,

the joy of continued health of mind and body, and through the intercession of the Virgin Mary, bring us into closer union with her Son, who leads us to the fullness of eternal life. Through Christ our Lord.
